name: SDNT1608X103J3950HTF
title: SDNT series chip NTC thermistors for temperature sensing, 0402 [01005] to 2012 [0805]
summary: SDNT is a family of surface-mount NTC thermistor chips for measuring temperature, made in five sizes from 0.4 × 0.2 mm to 2.0 × 1.25 mm and specified over -40 °C to +125 °C. Each part is set by its resistance at 25 °C (2.2 kΩ to 470 kΩ), its B constant between 25 °C and 50 °C (3380 K to 4350 K) and two tolerance codes, ±1 % to ±5 % on resistance and ±1 % or ±3 % on B. SDNT1005X103F3950FTF is the 1.0 × 0.5 mm (0402) part of 10 kΩ ±1 % with B25/50 = 3950 K ±1 %, on tape and reel.

notes: In each part number □ stands for the resistance tolerance code (F ±1%, H ±3%, J ±5%) and ◎ for the B constant tolerance code (F ±1%, H ±3%).
SDNT1005X103F3950FTF is SDNT1005X103□3950◎TF with both codes F.

pins.name: T1
pins.function: Metal termination on one end of the chip, the first contact of the NTC element.

pins.name: T2
pins.function: Metal termination on the other end of the chip, the second contact of the NTC element.

notes: SDNT1005X103F3950FTF reads: SDNT chip NTC thermistor, 1005 size (1.0 × 0.5 mm, inch code 0402), internal code X, 10 kΩ at 25 °C (103), resistance tolerance F (±1%), B25/50 of 3950 K, B tolerance F (±1%), tape and reel (T), hazardous-substance free (F).
The resistance code is three digits: two significant figures, then the number of zeros, in ohms (472 is 4.7 kΩ, 103 is 10 kΩ).

operation.text: A surface-mount NTC thermistor chip for sensing temperature. Its resistance falls as temperature rises. Listed uses: phones and wearables such as smart watches and true-wireless earphones; office machines such as printers, fax machines and word processors; temperature protection of batteries and CPUs.
The chips are surface-mount parts suited to high-density boards, with good solderability, and come in a range of B constants for different applications.

A part number is fixed by size, R25 and B constant (one of the combinations listed for that size), a resistance tolerance code (F, H or J) and a B tolerance code (F or H). Parts with other electrical characteristics are available on request.

Dissipation factor is 1.0 mW/°C for sizes 0402 to 1608 and 2.0 mW/°C for 2012. Maximum permissive operating current at 25 °C runs from 0.04 mA (470 kΩ, 0402) to 0.67 mA (2.2 kΩ, 1608); for SDNT1005X103F3950FTF it is 0.33 mA.
The thermal time constant is under 3 seconds for the 0402, 0603 and 1005 sizes and under 5 seconds for 1608 and 2012.
